normalized.result: Both work, and either is fine with me. Since the card already clearly flags "Original page unavailable · Saved copy ready," the automatic fallback feels clearer to me: I just click the bookmark the same way I always do, and it does the sensible thing by showing me the saved copy instead of a dead link — I don't have to learn a different button for this situation. The explicit "Open saved copy" button is also perfectly good and a bit more spelled-out. If you're choosing one, I'd lean toward the automatic fallback, but I'd be happy with either.
